# One command per line, run in order by .github/workflows/expo-upgrade.yml
npm view expo dist-tags
npm view @bacons/apple-targets dist-tags
npm view @bacons/apple-targets@latest peerDependencies
npm view react-native-purchases dist-tags
npm view @clerk/clerk-expo dist-tags
npm view nativewind dist-tags
npm view expo-hinge@latest version peerDependencies
npx expo install expo@^58.0.0
npx expo install --fix
npx expo install expo-hinge react-native-safe-area-context
